caseName: R.P. v. L. A. Cnty. Dep't of Children & Family Servs.
caseNameFull: R.P., et ux. v. LOS ANGELES COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILY SEVICES

opinions.text: Motion of respondent The Minor, Alexandria P. for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Motion of respondent Father J.E. for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeal of California, Second Appellate District denied.
